prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_grid_redesign: Redesign pet adoption into a clean responsive grid view showcasing pet personalities, traits, and desktop animations side-by-side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}}
1: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_quick_controls_flow: Add an interactive controls onboarding screen right before finishing, demonstrating how to drag, minimize, and summon the pet on screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_controls_intro", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"headline": "You're all set! Control your pet anytime", "body": "Use shortcuts or click your desktop pet to interact, feed, or minimize."}}
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_render_timer_badge: Display a dynamic rendering progress status with continuous time estimate countdown on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "emphasis", "action": "open_tip"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Preparing desktop engine...", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_session_restore_notification: Show a visible notification banner on the sign-in screen reassuring users that existing pets and progress will be safely linked.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign in to save your pet companion", "hint": "Signing in preserves your active pets, items, and settings across launches.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Account pet recovery enabled", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] new_screen_photo_upload_guidance: Insert a photo upload preparation screen before photo selection showing examples of clear lighting and best angles.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_upload_tips", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload your custom pet photos", "hint": "Ensure bright lighting and clear view of face for best rendering result."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_two_column_layout: Reorganize the path selection screen into a balanced two-column side-by-side card comparison for quick starter decision.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose your pet experience", "body": "Pick a ready-to-play companion or build your own custom pet from photos."}}
6: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_spotlight_redesign: Redesign the final completion screen using a spotlight layout that highlights the pet's location directly on the user's desktop screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "preview", "style": "highlight", "action": "next"}]}}}
7: [adoption, hint] adoption_certificate_desktop_shortcut_hint: Add a hint box on the adoption certificate screen explaining how to toggle pet visibility with desktop shortcuts.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime on desktop to summon or hide your pet."}}
8: [choose_path, copy] story_onboarding_welcome_copy_update: Update initial intro story headline and copy to clearly highlight how desktop pets live seamlessly on screen while working.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet your desktop pet companion", "body": "Adopt a cute interactive pet that lives right on your desktop and keeps you company while you work."}}
9: [finish, incentive] home_intro_starter_item_incentive: Add a visible starter pet toy unlock badge and celebration animation to the final onboarding screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocked: Free Starter Toy Pack!", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:confetti", "style": "large"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a grid layout while preserving the ability to choose a pet.
Adds an instructional screen within onboarding without removing required steps or altering external components.
Displays a rendering estimate timer on the waiting screen representing a real waiting state.
Adds a helpful sign-in status badge without requesting extra data or introducing unfair patterns.
Inserts a new guidance screen inside onboarding while retaining all mandatory steps.
Redesigns path selection layout while retaining both adopt and custom creation choices.
Redesigns the home intro screen while keeping its onboarding function intact.
Adds a desktop shortcut tip to the adoption certificate screen without modifying required features.
Updates intro copy on the story screen while maintaining its role of introducing the desktop pet.
Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Toy Pack!', violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras or gifts.
